title: Resource ledger
deliverable: Account for input windows, queued bytes, operation state, output, cache, artifacts and provider allocations.
acceptance: A deliberately expanding operation hits the declared budget; reported totals do not omit retained branch buffers.
strict_verification: Allocation capacity, provider scratch, queue retention, previews, fan-out, and disk reservations are charged; failures refund correctly and counters cannot wrap. Whole-run positive fuel and cumulative output/disk/branch/frame/register limits cannot reset on jumps, cache hits or child recipes; each noncooperative provider quantum has a hard host deadline.

title: Backpressure scheduler
deliverable: Add deterministic ready queues, bounded channels or equivalent credits and partial-output resumption.
acceptance: Slow consumers cannot grow memory indefinitely; synchronous CPU work does not depend on an async task per node.
strict_verification: Tiny-credit diamonds and stalled/failed joins complete or fail deterministically; no deadlock, starvation, unbounded queue, or credit leak remains.

title: Stream state machines
deliverable: Standardize EOF, truncation, cancellation, errors, logical record boundaries and output completion.
acceptance: Every state transition is tested; EOF is neither duplicated nor inferred from an arbitrary chunk boundary.
strict_verification: Enumerate input/output/EOF/error/cancel terminal transitions; duplicate EOF/finish and truncated tails cannot busy-loop or produce duplicate completion.

title: Multi-input ports
deliverable: Add constant parameters, immutable keys and synchronized data inputs with explicit joining policies.
acceptance: Arrival order cannot change XOR/key semantics; unresolved inputs block safely and never grow unbounded buffers.
strict_verification: Multi-port skew, missing/failed input, ordering, and unequal EOF cases follow typed port rules under bounded per-port and aggregate credit.

title: Branches and joins
deliverable: Implement graph regions, ordered fork/join, fan-out reference sharing and explicit merge policies.
acceptance: Reconverging branches, slow consumers and early exits do not deadlock or lose output.
strict_verification: Fork/join output ordering is invariant under scheduling; failed branches cancel dependents, and shared buffers stay charged until the last reference releases them.

title: Native artifact storage
deliverable: Introduce staged artifacts, immutable manifests, range reads, leases and verified finalization on local disk.
acceptance: Crash simulation cannot expose a partial artifact as complete; offsets and lengths are checked.
strict_verification: Real filesystem ranges/staging/integrity pass; traversal/symlink attempts, disk full, partial write, crash, and orphan cleanup cannot expose unfinished payloads.

title: Browser artifact storage
deliverable: Implement IndexedDB metadata and optional OPFS chunk storage with memory/file fallbacks.
acceptance: Firefox and other supported browsers work without optional APIs; quota failures never trigger silent upload.
strict_verification: Real worker IndexedDB/OPFS tests cover transaction completion/abort, quota, schema upgrade, denied persistence, and secret-sentinel exclusion.

title: Storage transaction discipline
deliverable: Add transaction-completion waits, chunk manifests, orphan cleanup and storage schema migrations.
acceptance: Aborted transactions and interrupted writes are reported; no successful-write result precedes commit confirmation.
strict_verification: Crash local native object-finalize/manifest and browser IndexedDB/OPFS transaction/local-event cut points; idempotent recovery exposes only completed locally authorized artifacts. This proves local storage discipline, not hosted SQL run/manifest/outbox publication, which qualifies in v0.112.0.
scope_context: This pass qualifies local native artifact manifests and browser IndexedDB/OPFS transaction completion, local event/outbox records and orphan recovery only. Hosted SQL manifest/run/outbox publication is owned by v0.112.0, not assumed here.

title: Whole-input and seekable adapters
deliverable: Support bounded accumulation, two-pass operations and seekable artifact readers.
acceptance: Non-streaming operations declare their class and reject oversized jobs before uncontrolled allocation.
strict_verification: Whole-input L-1/L/L+1 and unknown-length cases fail closed; seekable two-pass source mutation rejects, and spooling has real disk/work ceilings.

title: Semantic content identities
deliverable: Define canonical typed parameters, ordered ports, operation revision and chunk-independent input digests.
acceptance: Repartitioning input leaves identity unchanged; different parameters or operation semantics never reuse an entry accidentally.
strict_verification: Canonical identities include type, ordered inputs, arguments, semantic/provider/dataset revisions; chunk partition changes no identity and ambiguous framing collides nowhere in fixtures.

title: Selective computation cache
deliverable: Cache only deterministic, completed, permitted jobs using immutable input identities or completed spool hashes.
acceptance: Unknown streams are not fully buffered merely to attempt an early hit; secrets and failed jobs are excluded by default.
strict_verification: Only complete deterministic nonsensitive authorized results cache; secret/effectful/staged outputs deny, and cache identity includes current scope/revisions.

title: Cache lifecycle
deliverable: Add per-workspace quotas, reference pinning, eviction, cancellation cleanup and encrypted-at-rest hooks where configured.
acceptance: Eviction cannot delete a live artifact; cache misses and storage failures do not corrupt authoritative recipes.
strict_verification: TTL/eviction/revocation/poison/outage cases preserve truth and permissions; pending writers or stale grants cannot resurrect entries.

title: Bounded control-flow IR
deliverable: Represent labels, conditional branches, bounded repeats, registers and subrecipes separately from DAG regions.
acceptance: Graph-cycle rejection does not mistakenly eliminate required recipe loops; iteration/work budgets are enforced.
strict_verification: Bound compilation, SCC/region structure, frame depth, fuel, registers, output and artifacts; self/nested loops and amplification exhaust budgets predictably. Cyclic control transfers connect bounded regions, not cyclic stream queues; checked static loop estimates supplement monotonic runtime fuel, and irreducible compatibility jumps use a bounded frame/program-counter model.

title: Execution provenance
deliverable: Record operation revisions, argument redactions, input references, diagnostics and exact reproducibility conditions.
acceptance: Sensitive arguments stay out of logs; nondeterministic jobs cannot masquerade as reproducible cached results.
strict_verification: Provenance preserves exact source/operation revisions and offset availability; debug/event growth is bounded and records exclude payload/secret values.

title: Engine stress qualification
deliverable: Exercise huge streams, joins, cancellation, expansion bombs, temporary storage exhaustion and corrupt artifacts.
acceptance: Measured memory stays within each declared profile and errors remain recoverable; no universal constant-memory claim.
strict_verification: Large streaming plateaus in retained memory; adversarial partitions, queue interleavings, cancellation, and all execution classes pass stress/resource fixtures.
